VAR-psu.why: Key column labelled Primary Sampling Unit in main household table.
Key column psu in external consumption table (also PSU identifier).

VAR-strata.why: Household table includes a stratum field (complete 16).
External consumption table includes stratum (complete 16); also has strat00/05/10 variants.

VAR-urban.why: External consumption table has urban/rural variable (1 rural, 2 urban).

VAR-subnatid1.why: Geographic code: Region (likely highest admin grouping).
Administrative division code (candidate for highest-level subnational ID).

VAR-subnatid2.why: Geographic code: District (candidate for 2nd-level subnational ID).
District code appears in work activity section (may be an alternative district code variable).

VAR-subnatid3.why: Geographic code: Thana/Upazilla (candidate for 3rd-level subnational ID).

VAR-subnatid4.why: Geographic code: Union/Ward (candidate for 4th-level subnational ID).

VAR-subnatidsurvey.why: Geographic code: Mouza/Mohalla (most granular location code available).
If mouza is not consistently present/usable, Union/Ward may be the lowest stable location code.

VAR-geocode.why: Geocode is derived from lowest-level survey subnational ID; mouza/mohalla is the best candidate input.

VAR-gauladm1code.why: GAUL admin1 is derived via geocode; region/division-level code is the likely upstream input.
Administrative division code could be the upstream admin1 input for GAUL via geocode crosswalk.

VAR-gauladm2code.why: GAUL admin2 is derived via geocode; district-level code is the likely upstream input.

VAR-subnatid1prev.why: Previous-admin IDs are derived from geocode crosswalk, not directly collected; inspect geography crosswalk step.

VAR-subnatid2prev.why: Previous-admin IDs are derived from geocode crosswalk, not directly collected; inspect geography crosswalk step.

VAR-subnatid3prev.why: Previous-admin IDs are derived from geocode crosswalk, not directly collected; inspect geography crosswalk step.
